thread:
Ana R.: Hey team — ArgoCompute just dropped their collateral bundle for review: https://files.redwood.com/partners/argo/argo-collateral-v1.zip. Can design/legal/marketing quick-pass for any blockers?
Mike D.: grabbing the ZIP now. will scan logos + lockups first.
Mike D.: quick note — there are two logo variants: argo_logo_primary.svg and argo_logo_mark_only.svg. primary has tagline locked in.
Lela (Legal): tagging legal questions — do we have an approved trademark line? the PDF footer currently says "Argo is a trademark of ArgoCompute LLC" but no registration mark. need clarity.
Jordan (ArgoCompute): thx Lela — we prefer: "ArgoCompute® is a registered trademark of ArgoCompute LLC." i'll confirm with our counsel and send signed brand usage terms.
Sam K.: marketing: can we get a high-res 3:1 lockup (logo + Redwood lockup) and a version without the tagline? we need hero image options for the co-branded solution brief.
Mike D.: also found a few spacing issues — their lockup file (argo_redwood_lockup.ai) has 18px clearspace; our guidance is 24px for 600px widths. propose update.
Tess P.: timeline: we need final assets by Friday for the webinar landing page. is that feasible?
Jordan (ArgoCompute): aiming for EOD Thursday. i have the design lead on it.
Lela (Legal): heads up — Argo's legal asked to add this clause for case studies: "Customer results are based on customer-provided data and may vary." that's fine, but we should avoid any customer names without permission.
Sam K.: noted — we'll flag any customer name mentions. also request: can Argo provide a 2–3 sentence company blurb that matches our tone? current copy is quite product-heavy.
Jordan (ArgoCompute): sending two blurb options: concise and expanded. attaching here: https://files.redwood.com/partners/argo/argo-blurbs.txt
Mike D.: quick visual checklist i'm proposing: 1) primary & mark-only SVGs (transparent + white background) 2) 300/600/1200px PNG renditions 3) 3:1 and 1:1 lockups with clearspace set to 24px 4) color swatches in hex + Pantone if available 5) Figma file with component styles.
Ana R.: that checklist looks good. please call out any required exceptions back to me so we can escalate.
Mike D.: one exception: their purple (HEX #5A2ECC) is very close to our accent purple — suggest shifting to #5B2AD8 or adding a 2px hairline between marks in co-branded lockups to preserve separation.
Sam K.: marketing prefers color shift if Argo can accept. Jordan?
Jordan (ArgoCompute): color tweak is acceptable. we'll publish updated tokens.
Lela (Legal): once Jordan sends brand terms and trademark confirmation, i'll draft an approved usage blurb for legal copy in the footer.
Tess P.: for the solution brief PDF, can design export a web-optimized and print-optimized version? PR wants print for the conference.
Mike D.: yes — will export 150dpi print PDF + 72dpi web PDF, and include bleed marks.
Ana R.: perfect. if no blockers, i'll send the co-marketing ticket to ops to schedule the joint announcement next Monday.
Jordan (ArgoCompute): got it — we'll aim to finalize assets by Thu EOD. thanks everyone. :pray:
Mike D.: adding a tiny CSS snippet for web lockup placement that frontend asked for:
```
/* recommended lockup CSS */
.co-brand-lockup { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; vertical-align:middle; }
.co-brand-lockup img { height:36px; }
```
Mike D.: drop any dev questions in #partners-dev or ping me directly.
Sam K.: i'll follow up on the blurb tone and publish draft social copy once final assets are in.
Ana R.: closing loop — next check-in Thursday morning. thanks all. :thumbsup:
